# RDB Travels

> RDB Travels is an Ahmedabad-based car rental and outstation cab operator, running direct since 2015 (founder Ronak Dineshbhai Barot). Fleet: sedans, Innova/Crysta, 12–26 seater Tempo Travellers, and Volvo buses with professional drivers. Services include airport transfers, weddings, pilgrimage and corporate travel, and one-way/round-trip outstation routes across Gujarat and neighboring states. GST-compliant, transparent pricing with no broker markup. Contact: +91 92136 12377 (24×7 WhatsApp dispatch).

## Services

- [Car Rental in Ahmedabad](https://www.rdbtravels.com/car-rental-ahmedabad): Sedan, SUV, and Innova rentals with driver — local and outstation.
- [Tempo Traveller Hire in Ahmedabad](https://www.rdbtravels.com/tempo-traveller-hire-ahmedabad): 12 to 26 seater Tempo Travellers for groups, tours, and events.
- [Bus Hire in Ahmedabad](https://www.rdbtravels.com/bus-hire-ahmedabad): Volvo and mini bus rental for large groups and corporate travel.
- [Airport Transfer in Ahmedabad](https://www.rdbtravels.com/airport-transfer-ahmedabad): Fixed-fare pickups and drops for Ahmedabad (SVPI) airport.
- [Outstation Cab in Ahmedabad](https://www.rdbtravels.com/outstation-cab-ahmedabad): One-way and round-trip outstation cabs with transparent per-km pricing.
